caption:
Feel like it all must start and end with you? You're a channel, not the source. (1 Timothy 6:20–21 devotional)

The letter ends where it began: guard the deposit. The gospel isn't yours to own or alter — it's entrusted, to be handed on uncorrupted. You're not where it stops; you're the channel it flows on through, carried by grace. Thank you for walking all of 1 Timothy with us.
